theorems.name: Submission.allard52_amt_fubini_lintegral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (w : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (R ε s r : ℝ), 0 < ε → μ (closedBall y R) < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable w (μ.restrict (ball y R)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ball y R → 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ u : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < s → s ≤ r → (1 + ε) * r < R → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (w x * (∫ t in s..r, -(‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t)) / t / t ^ n)) ∂μ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in s..r, -(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * w x ∂μ) / t / t ^ n)
